natural_combat.scope: Real fixed-step continuous combat; sampled bot input, normal enemy AI, ordinary earned claims. No injected outcomes or reserve refill. Active seconds exclude menus/countdown/hit-stop; not human playtesting.

policy_occupancy_model.scope: 900-second synthetic occupancy model. Tests policy, caps and pacing; does not claim combat survival.

protected_physics_soak.scope: Protected-player 900-second real-physics load fixture. Player reserve is held at 0.8, ring-outs intercepted, full build installed. Not natural survival or balance evidence.
